latest_release.body: # Terminal size query vulnerability This patch version fixes a vulnerability reported by @Reload3d. You can find the details of the exploit [here](https://github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea/security/advisories/GHSA-qc58-pfg9-7pph). Best regards, Charm XX 💫 ## Changelog ### Fixed * 9c6c325f83348ee7215fb7a7aca3bc6316217056: fix: ingnore implausible terminal resize reports (#1887) (@andrinoff) ### Other stuff * 67b4c7a8a2b34a0b1ce15261b0c705bc7e1a04b7: v2.1.1 (@andrinoff) --- Thoughts? Questions? We love hearing from you. Feel free to reach out on [X](https://x.com/charmcli), [Discord](https://charm.land/discord), [Slack](https://charm.land/slack), [The Fediverse](https://mastodon.social/@charmcli), [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/charm.land).
